```{python}
#| label: fig-nmos-id-log
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Simulated transfer characteristic of an NMOS in IHP SG13 ($W = 1.3\\,\\mathrm{\\mu m}$, $L = 0.13\\,\\mathrm{\\mu m}$, $V_\\mathrm{SB} = 0$) on a logarithmic current axis. The exponential subthreshold region is clearly visible, as is the drain-voltage dependence caused by DIBL."

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

W = 1.3e-6
styles = ['-', '--', '-.']
vds_list = ['0p5', '1p0', '1p5']
labels = ['0.5 V', '1.0 V', '1.5 V']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
for fn, ls, lbl in zip(vds_list, styles, labels):
    d = pd.read_csv(f'content/mosfet/data/test_nmos_vd_{fn}.txt',
                    sep=r'\s+', header=None)
    y = np.abs(d[1]) / W / 1e-6 * 1e-6
    ax.semilogy(d[0], y, color='k', ls=ls, lw=1.5, label=lbl)

ax.set_xlabel('$V_\\mathrm{GS}$ (V)')
ax.set_ylabel('$I_\\mathrm{D} / W$ (µA/µm)')
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.5)
ax.grid(True, which='both', alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(title='$V_\\mathrm{DS}$', fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
